# isoplane bundle

Compile a managed deployment archive without login or building WASM.

```bash
isoplane bundle [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--project <project>` | Project directory (default: current directory). ISOPLANE_TARGET_DIR moves generated files outside it. |
| `--configuration <configuration>` | Build configuration (default: Release). |
| `--output <output>` | Output archive file. |
